page.layout: Running head at top centre; page number at top right. Two woodcut medallions with portrait inscriptions side by side, left then right. Below them one full-width text block of two paragraphs. Signature at the right beneath the text. A tailpiece ornament below the text, with no printed words.

main_text.l: F. ABR. ISAAC
REBECCA VX. ISAAC
ISAAC, filius Abrahæ & Saræ, natus est 14. annos post
Ismaelem: oblatus anno ætatis 13. vt alij volunt 25. qui erat
annus mundi 2073. ante Christum natum 1889. anno ætatis 40.
vxorem duxit Rebeccam filiam Bathuelis Syri, de Mesopota-
mia, sororem Laban, vt Abraham pater eius statuerat. anno 60.
nati sunt illi ex Rebecca gemelli, prior Esau rufus, & totus his-
pidus: alter, Iacob, protinus egressus est, plantam fratris manu
tenens. anno ætatis 180. mortuus est, & appositus populo suo.
Vide Gene. 25. & 35. cap. item Iosep. lib. Anti. 1. cap. 26. & 28.
REBECCA nupsit Isaac anno mundi 2090. ante Chri-
stum natum 1872. hæc effecit vt Iacob benedictionem à patre
præriperet, quæ Esau promittebatur. Nam cùm feni Isaac oculi
caligaret, obtrusit ei Rebecca Iacob indutum vestibus Esau, ac
pelliculis hædorum circunfultū manus & collum, interea dum
venatum isset Esau, vt pulmētum patri pararet: mox autem re-
diens Esau, vt audiuit se præuentum, interminatus est mortem
fratri Iacob. Id dum rescit Rebecca, mittit Iacob ad Laban, do-
nec furor & indignatio Esau temperetur. Tandem mittens
Iacob munera fratri, placatus est. Vide Gene. 27. 32. 33. cap. Iose.
lib. Antiq. 1. à cap. 26. ad calcem vsque.

page.notes: The medallion inscriptions are printed on the woodcuts; the right one reads "VX." with a dot after it. The tailpiece ornament at the foot has no text. Spelling "rescit" follows the long-s rule; the print shows "refcit". "pulmētum" and "circunfultū" are transcribed with their printed macrons, which may be slightly uncertain at this resolution.
